candidates.title: Value of items report
candidates.statement: The system shall generate a value-of-items report that computes the monetary value of items based on the purchase price data in item records for the entire collection or any portion of the collection.
candidates.source_quote: Value of items report - staff should be able to get the value of items based on data in item records.

candidates.title: Value report filter options
candidates.statement: The system shall allow the value-of-items report to be filtered by item attributes and statuses such as item status (e.g., "longoverdue"), material type (e.g., DVDs), and collection membership (e.g., children's collection).
candidates.source_quote: For example, they want to be able to get: - Value of all items with status "longoverdue" - Value of all DVDs in children's collection

candidates.title: Aggregate purchase price field
candidates.statement: The system shall be able to query and aggregate the purchase price field from item records to support value calculations and reports.
candidates.source_quote: The data is already in the item records (purchase price field). We just need the system to be able to query and aggregate this.

candidates.title: Patron account balances report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports of patron account balances, with grouping and filtering by individual patron, home library (branch), and the entire system.
candidates.source_quote: Patron account balances by patron, home library, and system

candidates.title: Fines and charges by time period and type
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports of fines and charges accrued per specified time periods (e.g., last 12 months, year-to-date, last month) and optionally broken down by type of charge (e.g., overdue fines, damaged item charges, lost item charges).
candidates.source_quote: Fines and charges accrued per time period (last 12 months, YTD, last month) ... and per type of charge (overdue fines, damaged item charges, lost item charges, etc.)

candidates.title: Fines waived by time period and branch
candidates.statement: The system shall report fines waived, with the ability to group and filter by time period and by branch/library.
candidates.source_quote: Fines waived per time period and per branch
candidates.priority_signals: Each library has its own budget for waived fines.

candidates.title: Payments by time period and collection channel
candidates.statement: The system shall report payments made per specified time period and by collection channel (e.g., staff desk, self-check station, OPAC) to support reconciliation and reporting.
candidates.source_quote: Payments made per time period and per payment method (staff desk, self-check, OPAC)

candidates.title: Payments by payment instrument
candidates.statement: The system shall report payments grouped by payment instrument/type (e.g., cash, credit card, check, ecommerce) to assist with daily and monthly reconciliation.
candidates.source_quote: The financial reports need to show payments by method - cash, credit card, check, etc.

candidates.title: Audit trail ledger for payments
candidates.statement: The system shall maintain an auditable ledger of patron payments that records each payment and the specific charges to which the payment was applied, enabling full traceability for reconciliation.
candidates.source_quote: The financial audit trail is CRITICAL ... trace every payment back to the specific charge it was applied to.
candidates.priority_signals: CRITICAL; needed to reconcile accounts properly.

candidates.title: Compliance with accounting and auditing requirements
candidates.statement: The system shall ensure that all reports and data archiving comply with standard accounting practices and state, county, and municipal auditing requirements.
candidates.source_quote: All reports and data archiving must comply with standard accounting practice and state, county, and municipal auditing requirements.

candidates.title: Data retention policy enforcement
candidates.statement: The system shall enforce data retention policies required by law and policy, including retaining specified financial data for required periods (e.g., seven years) for audit purposes.
candidates.source_quote: Some data needs to be retained for 7 years for audit purposes. The system needs to enforce retention policies.
candidates.priority_signals: retain for 7 years; enforce retention policies

candidates.title: Join patron and item financial data
candidates.statement: The system shall support joining financial data attached to patron records and to item records so that financial reports can combine or correlate those data sources.
candidates.source_quote: The financial data is attached to patron records AND item records. So when we query for financial reports, we need to be able to join these data sources.

candidates.title: Query accounts above balance threshold
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff users to query and retrieve patron accounts with balances greater than a specified threshold value (e.g., greater than X dollars).
candidates.source_quote: Staff should be able to query patron accounts with balances greater than X dollars.
candidates.priority_signals: Repeatedly requested; currently takes forever manually.

candidates.title: Immediate update of financial information
candidates.statement: The system shall update and reflect financial transactions (such as payments made at the front desk) immediately so that reports and account balances are current in real time or near-real time.
candidates.source_quote: When a patron makes a payment at the front desk, we need the system to reflect that immediately.
candidates.priority_signals: Staff need immediate reflection; 'takes forever' currently.

candidates.title: Branch-level payment tracking and visibility
candidates.statement: The system shall track payments by collection location/library and provide branch-level visibility so each branch can see payments collected at their location for end-of-month and other reports.
candidates.source_quote: Payments tracking by library is important for our end-of-month reports. Each branch needs to be able to see what payments were collected at their location.

candidates.title: Attach financial transactions to records
candidates.statement: The system shall record fines, charges, waivers, and ecommerce transactions as data elements attached to patron records and to item records.
candidates.source_quote: Fines, charges, waivers, and ecommerce transactions are attached to patron and item records.
